name: duopore-public-catalog
description: Find missing product details and data errors before you prepare an online shop listing.

interface.longDescription: Find missing product details and data errors before you prepare an online shop listing. Share the product rows you want to check. Match your column names, check barcode numbers, and find gaps such as missing prices or stock. Use the website to choose products and export a cleaned file. ChatGPT checks up to 1,000 rows per request. The tool does not upload products to a marketplace.
defaultPrompt: Check my supplier spreadsheet for product data errors.
Match these supplier columns to the product fields I need.
